needs: Mr Whitfield, aged 63, has recently retired and received a lump sum of approximately R6.2 million. He requires a monthly income of about R28,000 to supplement his pension. He has a long time horizon of 15 years or more. Capital preservation is his primary concern, though he recognises the need for some growth to keep pace with inflation. He prefers a predominantly local, income-oriented mandate with limited offshore exposure.

objective.riskProfile: Conservative to moderate. Capital preservation is the priority, with sufficient growth to protect the real value of capital over the long term. The portfolio must be able to fund a regular monthly income without forcing the sale of growth assets during market drawdowns.
